title: First usable todos panel
changes: Todo lists from a TODOS.md file in a small herdr side panel
Click a todo to write in it; Return starts the next one
Drag todos to reorder them or move them between lists
Click the box to tick a todo; it moves to Done
Sub-items with Tab, indent guides, and collapsible groups
Long todos wrap; outside edits to TODOS.md show up live
Undo and redo with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, mac-style text keys
Optional green phosphor look, toggled with t
